title: Formula catalog (producer: math-trace, templates/<name>/equations.json)
description: Each key is a formula name. Each value comes from a Formula(...) call in the template's src/model.py, and source_line is the line where that call starts. The adapter in equations_history.formula_catalog is the runtime check; this file is the contract that both repos point at.

units_lhs.description: Units of the left-hand side, pint-parseable. Empty when not an equation. Optional until every template declares it.

units_rhs.description: Units of the right-hand side, in the same form as units_lhs. Both sides must have the same dimensions.
